PTX-1.proof: Host and transferred exact-target pure_tail receipts; copied_binary_tail_fold_crosses_the_former_frame_boundary in workspace_tests.
PTX-1.result: Copied discovery/standard inspection/new/compact plan/apply/definition/check/build/run; runtime lists 0, 1, 256, 4096, 8192 give fixed arithmetic sums in both tiers. Long per-tier frame peaks are equal and below eight. Complete accepted inventories remain unchanged across plan, reads and execution failures; only reviewed apply advances meaning.

PTX-2.proof: Pure-tail outcomes run-29 through run-35 and bounded_stack cases in both candidate receipts.
PTX-2.result: Self countdown returns zero at 8192; named-invoke mutual parity returns true/false at 8192/8191. Removed non-built-in producer supplies cross-package rank-one generic recursion through if/let/sequence/match, preserving ordered i64/bool instantiations with results -17 and true. Ordered subtraction folds return 5 and -5.

PTX-3.proof: Each pure-tail receipt retains 44 bounded-stack cases with actual owned call/control/local/type peaks and zero post-execution state.
PTX-3.result: Both tiers run in subprocess-contained 2 MiB evaluator threads with frame admission eight: unchanged positive sizes, genuine non-tail depth errors, infinite recursion fuel exhaustion at 1000 units, cancellation after 37 host calls, exact-fit/one-over allocation and VM operand limits, and healthy subsequent invocations discriminate resource behavior.

PTX-4.proof: Pure-tail order/fault cases plus workspace terminal_only_analysis_* and pure_tail_transfer_rechecks_operand_base_exact_callee_and_caller_authority / pure_tail_fault_cannot_discard_an_owned_transaction.
PTX-4.result: Unselected traps stay unselected; selected early argument and invoke-callee traps prevent later work. Pending record/projection/sequence work retains calls. Invalid targets, jump cycles, operand residue, foreign callable/type identity, task/transaction authority and forced ordinary-frame growth are rejected or detected. The independent canonical reference ignores the production-dispatch fault.

PTX-5.proof: standalone_http and transaction_cancellation in both pure-tail receipts; service_acceptance and inherited stateful/outbound/worker/interactive/data/queue/object protection gates.
PTX-5.result: After every project/dependency directory is removed, raw HTTP receives 33558528 and an independent state read sees one committed change. Helper overflow returns HTTP 500 and leaves one change; healthy HTTP adds the second. Deterministic cancellation after staging leaves the cancelled key absent and zero live transaction/control state; the same resident and grants then commit the third change. Effects execute once through production only.

PTX-6.proof: Each pure-tail receipt binds its original/reviewed artifact and authority inventories; full maintained generation/comparison gates; pure_tail_preparation_executes_the_unchanged_maintained_standard_artifact.
PTX-6.result: Clean, exact-current, missing/corrupt-cache recovery and post-reviewed-change incremental/clean artifacts agree for equal inputs. Canonical damage remains pack_entry_checksum and preserves the damaged inventory before exact private-fixture restoration. Pre-campaign same-format standard bytes execute the new guarantee without conversion. Maintained graph, dependency and asset bytes are unchanged; generated discovery and current consumers agree.

PTX-7.result: 26 fresh full gates, zero reuse, every product gate, and nine fresh exact x86_64-unknown-linux-musl admission classifications, including the transferred public pure-tail workflow. Staticness is direct ELF inspection plus the two exact pinned userland executions.
